{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment is consistently negative over recent days, indicating bearish momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias when model forecasts are significantly above historical mean over 30-day window, especially with low sentiment.",
    "Increase downward correction magnitude if sentiment is positive but price is trending downward, suggesting sentiment reversal.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; maintain smoother transitions unless sentiment is strongly divergent.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5–10% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "When sentiment is positive but forecast is consistently high, reduce forecast by 5–15% to avoid overconfidence bias.",
    "If sentiment is neutral and price is trending upward, slightly increase forecast to capture momentum, but cap at 10% above recent high."
  ]
}
